name: Dominion Transmission TL-527 Line Project

values.OtherEnglishNames: Dominion Northeast TL-527 Line Project; Dominion Transmission TL-527 Line Project

researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 401: Dominion Northeast TL-527 Line Project, sponsor Dominion Transmission, type Lateral, Completed 2006-06-16, states WV,PA,NY, 23.67 mi, 200 MMcf/d (incremental), diameters 8, 16 and 20 in, interstate, FERC docket CP04-365. url_verifier passed with the EIA project name. Single origin: web searches found no FERC order, Federal Register notice or operator release naming TL-527, so no second source. Not a match to an existing row: no roster row carries TL-527 or CP04-365; parent system P0176 Dominion Gas Pipeline is a whole-system row, and P2630 shows the expansion-row shape used here. Caveats: a 23.67 mi lateral listed across three states (WV, PA, NY) is odd, so start and end points were left blank until a FERC filing confirms them. EIA cost column (31.15) was not staged because its unit was not confirmed. Owner recorded as the source spells it; no legal form confirmed. Length is above the 15.5 mi threshold but rests on EIA alone, so tier is medium. No route found.
